name: 5-fungo ni Igai na Ketsumatsu Monochrome no Toshokan
original_name: 5分後に意外な結末 モノクロームの図書館
source:
The game features 100 game-original stories with unique graphics and sounds, described as sometimes fun, other times scary, and occasionally moving. Each story can be completed in five minutes and ends with an unexpected twist. The stories available to read are determined by speaking to the game’s two librarians—the angelic Whi and devilish Lack—allowing you to forge your own story depending on what kind of conversations you have.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/11/sound-novel-5-fun-go-ni-igai-na-ketsumatsu-monochrome-no-toshokan-announced-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
遊戲收錄了一百篇原創故事，每篇都有獨特的畫面和音效。有的讓人忍俊不禁，有的叫人毛骨悚然，也有些會讓人動容。每篇只需五分鐘就能讀完，結尾總有意想不到的轉折。下一本能讀到什麼，取決於你和兩位圖書館員的交談。一位是天使般的懷，一位是惡魔般的拉克，而你和他們說過的話也將串起一個只屬於你的故事。

（來源：[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/11/sound-novel-5-fun-go-ni-igai-na-ketsumatsu-monochrome-no-toshokan-announced-for-switch]Gematsu[/url]）
